keywords: Alice 在 L1 私密兑换
EIP-8182 增加投递密钥注册表与 X-Wing
开放与密封 MEV 拍卖
summary: ACDC #176 确认 glamsterdam-devnet-0 目标 4 月中，讨论 ePBS 的 PTC 回看与 Engine API 可选 SSZ。soispoke 发布 Alice swaps privately on L1，说明 EIP-8141 原生 AA、2D nonce 等四项升级如何逐步消除隐私协议对广播者的依赖。RogerPodacter 为 EIP-8182 加入投递密钥注册表与 X-Wing 基线方案，提交并合并。ethresear.ch 指出对隐私而言，后量子迁移比认证迁移更紧迫。

items.title: soispoke：Alice swaps privately on L1
items.note: 18:07：如今隐私协议用户依赖能看到、抢跑并审查其交易的广播者，线程说明四项未来协议升级如何一步步去掉这一依赖，起点是原生 AA（EIP-8141）与 2D nonce。
items.title_en: soispoke: Alice swaps privately on L1
items.note_en: 18:07: privacy protocol users today rely on broadcasters that can see, frontrun and censor their transactions; the thread shows how four future protocol upgrades remove that dependency step by step, starting with native AA (EIP-8141) and 2D nonces.
items.topic_en: Privacy: from broadcasters to the protocol

items.title_en: EIP-8182: add a delivery key registry, X-Wing baseline scheme, remove delegated registration
items.note_en: (RogerPodacter), submitted and merged, updating the enshrined private transfers EIP merged on March 17.
items.topic_en: Privacy: from broadcasters to the protocol

items.title: ethresear.ch：后量子对以太坊隐私的威胁
items.note: 16:29：面对先收集后解密，长期保密数据的迁移比认证迁移更紧迫，因为签名伪造还能靠硬分叉与密钥迁移部分补救，被收集的密文则无法挽回。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: Post-Quantum Threats to Ethereum Privacy
items.note_en: 16:29: under harvest now decrypt later, migrating long lived confidential data is more urgent than migrating authentication, since signature forgery can be partly remedied by hard forks and key migration while harvested ciphertexts cannot be recovered.

items.title: ACDC #176

items.note_en: 21:00, per Ethereal news #16: glamsterdam-devnet-0 targeted for mid April, with ePBS discussion of the PTC look behind and missing parent beacon block roots; the Engine API discussion covered optional SSZ, a redesign and versioning; Hegotá non headliner EIPs can be proposed once the execution layer headliner is chosen, with EIP-8148 custom sweep threshold for validators already proposed.

keywords_en: EIP-8182 adds a delivery key registry and X-Wing
summary_en: ACDC #176 set glamsterdam-devnet-0 for mid April and discussed the ePBS PTC look behind and optional SSZ in the Engine API. soispoke posted Alice swaps privately on L1, showing how four upgrades including EIP-8141 native AA and 2D nonces remove privacy protocols' dependence on broadcasters. RogerPodacter added a delivery key registry and an X-Wing baseline scheme to EIP-8182, submitted and merged. An ethresear.ch post argued that post-quantum migration is more urgent for privacy than for authentication.
